capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Page says “64.8 kWh high-voltage battery” without saying gross or usable; recorded as gross.

chemistry.notes: NCM (NMC) for the 2024 North American 64.8 kWh Kona Electric; same pack on the Canadian 2026 car (64.8 kWh per Hyundai Canada).

preconditioning.notes: Hyundai 2025 US SX2EV manual page: automatic when a DC charging station is set as destination or waypoint, plus manual "Activate" from the infotainment menu. Page does not name the model (SX2EV = Kona Electric), so low confidence. Estimated: 2025 manual carried to this model year/market (same generation). Hyundai Canada 2026 page only says the battery pre-warms while plugged in; navigation trigger and manual control taken from the US SX2EV manual, same generation.

published_10_80_min.notes: “Approximately 43 minutes” on a Level 3 charger (>100 kW); the same page's FAQ says about 45 minutes.
